title: Tofu scramble with vegetables
steps: Pat the tofu dry and crumble it roughly with a fork.
Dice the pepper and fry it in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric and paprika and fry for 5 minutes, turning, until lightly browned.
Fold in the spinach and halved tomatoes and cook briefly.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with toasted bread.
